notes: Moss Works on Steam, decisions of the operator on 2026-11-14, with the bands of group A3 of the interview.
length_h is the length to the hard end (S28.last_step): 6 active hours, inside the default band 3 to 6 hours (SG:177-178).

The demo ends at 120 minutes, before the Dew Garden (S23) opens. This is longer than the guide band of 15 to 30 minutes (SG:183). The nearest proof is the 1 to 2 hour Tower Wizard prototype (SG:189), so the record marks it unsupported.
purchase_gap replaces the session target: the largest gap between purchases is at most 2 minutes, and the first purchase comes inside 2 minutes (SG:180-181).

The unlock gap targets (purchase_gap.unlock_max_min 10 and unlock_first_hour_max_min 5) are designer targets with no source (CT6, CT7): the operator set them on 2026-11-14. 5 minutes is the first-hour result that ticket T-16 required.
The unlock targets, the active factor and the play-test speed have no source in the short games (SG:198-204). They are designer targets, not supported by a source.
run_min is the run length of the reset layer: 15 minutes, the default of the balance math.
No offline gain, so the targets have no closed idle value. The open idle bands are the law band 0 to 1, not targets.

unlocks.first_hour 6 is below the count that the 5-minute first-hour gap forces: ceil(60 / 5) - 1 = 11 (references/interview.md, A1.3). The solver takes the band of a continuous game from the gap, so the record marks the unlocks unsupported. The value 6 stays, because the committed design tests/designs/moss-works-demo uses it for its first stage times.
